welcome: 💎 {name} — welcome! 🤍 You are in the {brand} anonymous chat bot. Your messages go directly to the admin. You stay anonymous, but the admin can see your activity and statistics. 📋 Commands: /start — start /help — help /profile — your profile /status — admin status /clear — clear history /stop — stop chat /feedback — rate the bot /lang — change language ✍️ Send a message — the admin will see it.
help: 📖 Help User commands: /start — start the bot /help — help /profile — your profile & statistics /status — is admin online? /clear — clear chat history /stop — stop chat /feedback — rate the bot (1-5 ⭐) /lang — change language How it works? Every message you send goes to the admin. The admin sees your anonymous nickname. You'll get a reply from the admin. 🔒 Anonymity: Your name and username are only visible to the admin, other users can't see them. ⚠️ Spam or abusive messages will be blocked.
status: 🟢 Admin: online Admin will reply soon. — or — 🔴 Admin: offline Auto-reply is on. Your message was received, admin will reply when online.
stop: 🛑 Chat stopped. Send me a message to start again. 🤍
feedback_prompt: ⭐ Please rate the bot from 1 to 5:
feedback_thanks: 🙏 Thanks for your feedback! Your opinion matters to us.
feedback_comment_prompt: 💬 Want to leave a comment? Send it or /skip:
blocked: 🚫 You are blocked. Your messages won't be accepted anymore.
spam_warning: ⚠️ Please follow the rules. Spam or abusive messages will be blocked.
message_sent: ✅ Your message was sent to the admin. Waiting…
auto_reply: 🤖 Auto-reply: your message was received, admin will reply soon.
rate_limited: ⏳ Please slow down. You're sending too many messages.
not_in_chat: ℹ️ Start the chat first. Press /start.
flood_blocked: ⏸ You stopped the chat. To resume — press /start.
